name: Rainforest Foundation US
summary: A US non-profit that backs Indigenous peoples in the Amazon and Central America to secure and defend their forest: titling their land, training and paying community patrollers who act on satellite deforestation alerts, and strengthening and funding their own organisations, in Peru, Brazil, Guyana and Panama.

spending.source: https://rainforestfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/RFUS-Audit-Financial-Statement-2025.pdf (combined financial statements of Rainforest Foundation, Inc and Affiliate, December 31, 2025, audited; statement of activities p. 4: program services $9,291,415 of total expenses $11,254,243)

lines.label: Indigenous forest protection: land rights, rainforest protection (community monitoring) and strengthening Indigenous organizations
lines.source: https://rainforestfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/RFUS-Audit-Financial-Statement-2025.pdf (p. 4, calendar year 2025: program services $9,291,415; the audited accounts don't split programmes). The 2024 Form 990, Part III (IRS e-file XML, object 202533219349314688) splits the year before into land rights $1,287,905, rainforest protection $1,751,791 and strengthening Indigenous organizations $4,841,866 of $7,881,562. One line because charityevals models all three as branches of one conservation model.
